purpose: Describe the R7 baseline and C4*/C6* changes, plus proposed examples and comparisons.
source_boundaries: Appendix B describes component roles. Appendix A supplies ATAM-based findings and refinements.
These descriptions and model tests do not prove what historical software implemented.

baseline_evidence.conceptual_responsibility: C4 decides access and sends any restrictions.
baseline_evidence.conceptual_source: Requirements Appendix B, Section A R7 and Table C R7
baseline_evidence.operational_assessment: Appendix A lists C4.1-C4.3, but not a named C4.4 Obligation Handler.

baseline_evidence.conceptual_responsibility: C6 checks access and applies restrictions before releasing records.
baseline_evidence.conceptual_source: Requirements Appendix B, Section A R7 and Table C R7
baseline_evidence.operational_assessment: Appendix A reports C6.6 specified but not active at every gateway.

change.name: Obligation Handler
change.responsibility: Prepare restrictions to send with the C4 access decision.

variations.boundary: Preparing restrictions is not the same as applying them.
variations.interface_effect: C6 must understand the restrictions C4 sends; exact API is not specified.
variations.state_effect: No new persistent state owner is established.

change.name: Data Minimizer
change.responsibility: Make data-minimization enforcement available at each C6 gateway.

variations.boundary: The baseline already describes masking and filtering as C6 duties.
variations.interface_effect: C6 must understand restrictions and scope from C4/C15.
variations.state_effect: This request does not imply persistent session state.

configurations.boundary: Extra proposed rules, not evidence of historical baseline behaviour.

responsibility_checks.responsibility: C4 returns allow/deny and any restrictions.
responsibility_checks.required_evidence: Evidence about decision and restriction selection.

responsibility_checks.responsibility: C6 applies the decision and all restrictions before release.
responsibility_checks.required_evidence: Evidence about enforcement and failure handling.

responsibility_checks.responsibility: C15 limits which records are retrieved.
responsibility_checks.required_evidence: Evidence about scope and C6/C15 agreement.

responsibility_checks.responsibility: C5 records access and enforcement results.
responsibility_checks.required_evidence: Evidence about audit messages and logging.

state_checks.documented_ownership: C4.2 is the named policy registry.
state_checks.boundary: Actual storage and consistency are not tested.

state_checks.documented_ownership: C14 manages consent credentials and status.
state_checks.boundary: C14 is relevant only when using the credential path.

state_checks.information: Decision and obligations for the current request
state_checks.boundary: A temporary request does not require a stored session.

assessment_boundaries: A named new subcomponent does not alone prove that the baseline failed.
C4* prepares restrictions; C6* enforces them. Both still need compatible meanings.
T1-T10 and the variation experiment run proposed examples, not real historical services.
The authorization scope is assumed correct; no real FHIR, audit delivery or performance is tested.
Coverage decisions are made separately in r7_reference_assessment.json.

proposed_logical_rules.status: Proposed model only; independent review pending.
proposed_logical_rules.I2-RESPONSE: C4 sends restrictions. C6 applies all, or blocks release if invalid or unsupported.
proposed_logical_rules.I3-SCOPE: C15 filters allowed IDs and dates. C6 then enforces masking. Supplied scope is trusted.
proposed_logical_rules.I4-DATA: Only the filtered and masked result is released. Never release partial results.
proposed_logical_rules.boundary: The tests use flat example records, not real FHIR systems or baseline implementations.

proposed_selection_example.evidence_boundary: A fixed example, not proof of general policy or consent correctness.

comparison_policy.scope: One authenticated R7 request with fixed policy and consent.
comparison_policy.common_criteria: Use the same R7 checks for all four variants.
comparison_policy.controlled_differences: Change only the documented C4* and C6* designs.
comparison_policy.fair_comparison_rule: Use the same inputs, rules and expected results; proposed rules must not favor one design.
comparison_policy.result_boundary: Model results depend on assumptions and do not prove historical baseline gaps.

allocation.C15: Restrict records by allowed IDs and dates.
allocation.C6: Deny before retrieval; mask fields before release.

proposed_retrieval_example.boundary: Example only; not a real FHIR service.

test_evidence.cases: T1-T5 test supplied decisions; T6 tests selection; T7-T10 test scope and retrieval.
test_evidence.boundary: Test results do not establish historical coverage or general correctness.

common_contract.obligations: Apply all masking and date restrictions; unsupported rules block release.
common_contract.scope: C15 limits IDs/dates; C6 masks and rechecks dates.

profiles.rationale: Assume all four configurations can prepare and enforce restrictions.
Assume baseline preparation and enforcement are unavailable, based on ATAM concerns. This is not proven.

executable_comparison.unavailable_mechanism_rule: Block disclosure if a required restriction cannot be prepared or enforced.

additional_selection_cases.name: Apply both restrictions to allowed records
Block access if scope is missing
Return no records when scope is empty

executable_comparison.oracle_rule: Compare results with manually written expected outcomes.
executable_comparison.result_boundary: Functional, assumption-based comparison only; not historical evidence or DES.
